applicability.description: Normalize heterogeneous record collections into a canonical schema {id, name, amount_cents, tags}. Engine consumes pre-parsed records plus a field map declaring which source keys correspond to id/name/amount/tags; it coerces USD-formatted strings to integer cents, splits delimited tag fields, and preserves input order.
requires_markers: records contain a monetary field formatted as USD string (e.g. $1,234.56, 12.50, -5.00, ($3.00))
records contain a tags field as delimited string or as a list
the source key names for id/name/amount/tags are identifiable, possibly with alternates
a field map is provided binding canonical names to those source keys
claims: emits JSON list of objects with exactly {id, name, amount_cents, tags}
coerces USD strings to integer cents handling '$', thousands commas, decimals, leading '-', and accounting parentheses
splits delimited tag strings into a trimmed non-empty list
accepts tag fields already given as a list
accepts alternate candidate keys per canonical field (string-or-list)
exits 0 on success and 1 on any exception

limitations: engine does not parse source formats; adapter must deliver pre-parsed records
USD-only currency semantics; non-USD symbols beyond '$' are stripped but not converted
no nested-key resolution in engine; adapter must flatten or supply dotted keys
single tag delimiter per run as configured in field map
no tag deduplication or case normalization
no schema validation beyond the four canonical fields
amount coercion assumes the value represents whole or fractional dollars, not cents
